verdict.rationale: Scribe is API-first. The core transcription features are all exposed programmatically: synchronous fast mode, WebSocket live streaming, S3 batch jobs, diarization, language detection, text polishing, and full list/delete endpoints for vocabulary assets. The UI playground's inputs (record, upload, URL) map onto these API modes. However, nothing documents an explicit API/UI parity guarantee. Credential administration (expiration, IP allowlist, scope selection) is described only as console steps, with no API equivalent shown. Missing for 10: a documented API/UI parity statement, API endpoints for credential and key management, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.
